title: OutLayer 솔로 #015 · Polynesian goddess · 체리 레드 PVC 지퍼 탑+미니 · 오버니삭스/레그워머 · 머리 넘기기 · 경복궁 마당
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, Polynesian goddess physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person; a powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, a thick sturdy torso with only a soft, gentle waistline, and enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it, every curve large, solid and continuous rather than sharply cinched anywhere; thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing; her head stays in correct proportion to her broad frame; solid and continuous rather than dramatically contoured; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids natural black hair — wearing a tight cropped sleeveless glossy cherry-red PVC zip-front top with a high collar, a chrome front zipper unzipped from the collar all the way down to her belly button where the chrome slider rests at her navel, the two zipper edges with their metal teeth running in a long deep V along her sternum and stomach, each side of the top covering one breast, paired with a glossy cherry-red PVC micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her midriff bare below the zipper. Her left leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her left calf and knee and ending high on her left thigh, running down into her heel. Her right leg wears a pastel pink chunky ribbed knit leg warmer slouched in soft folds around her right calf from just above the ankle to just below the knee, her right knee, thigh and the top of her foot bare, the warmer resting above her heel. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme Polynesian goddess silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy cherry-red PVC, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy cherry-red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a long silver chain ending in a heavy gold anvil-shaped weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: the wide granite courtyard of Gyeongbokgung Palace with a standard-height palace gate, low stone steps and a waist-high stone balustrade, empty of visitors, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
